title: Law to require better warnings before Buildings Dept tax liens
summary: This bill would require Department of Buildings violation notices that can become tax liens to warn owners of that risk, and require notice within three days of an Environmental Control Board judgment explaining payment options and steps to avoid or remove a lien. It would also require the Buildings and Finance departments to publish annual data on lien conversions and to conduct outreach to owners of one- and two-family homes. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
